sources.fact: When howling, additional Strength (HP) +200; current official character guide, not a decoded Reboot or mutation parameter.
Historic PC wolf shield descriptions; version differs from the supplied PC archive.
Historic basic wolf shield of 99 HP, rechargeable by roaring.

implementation: Explicit offline adaptation: a completed howl replenishes (never adds) 200 normal-form or 99 mutation-form extra HP. Damage consumes extra HP first. Interrupted/restarted howls grant nothing. Clears on transformation, respawn, mutation and character replacement. These caps are not certified values for every PC variant. No unverified howl speed multiplier.
